name: National Government Services Portal
services: Search government services by keyword, category, state/district and government level
use: National index/discovery layer; listings are informational and may link to state/department portals.

name: ServicePlus
services: State service catalogues, applications, tracking, certificates and status
use: Many state portals are ServicePlus instances; not every state or service uses it.

name: UMANG
services: State and central service discovery, registration, application and status where integrated
use: Aggregates partner department services; destination and content remain with the partner department.

name: DigiLocker
services: Fetch, store, share and verify issued digital documents
use: Use as document issuer/requester integration; do not treat a user-uploaded file as an issuer-verified document.

name: National Scholarship Portal
services: Central and State scholarship applications, institute/officer verification and tracking
use: Scheme availability, application window and eligibility must be checked each academic year.

name: NFSA State/UT Ration Card Portals
services: State/UT food portals and ration card beneficiary information
use: New ration-card issuance and eligibility are handled by the respective State/UT, not by NFSA central portal.

name: Parivahan / mParivahan
services: Sarathi driving licence services, Vahan vehicle registration, eChallan and state-wise services
use: State-specific RTO workflows, login and appointment rules still apply.

name: Passport Seva
services: Fresh/reissue passport, Tatkaal, Police Clearance Certificate, appointment and tracking
use: Authentication and appointment flow remain on official portal.

name: UIDAI My Aadhaar
services: Aadhaar download/order, update/status, appointment and VID/security services
use: OTP and biometric actions must be citizen-controlled.

name: Election Commission Voters' Services Portal
services: New voter registration, correction, deletion, e-EPIC, electoral roll, polling station and status
use: State/constituency context and citizen authentication required.

name: PM-KISAN
services: New farmer registration, beneficiary status, eKYC and corrections
use: Eligibility and eKYC rules are governed by scheme guidelines and state verification.

name: eShram
services: Unorganised worker registration, UAN card and profile updates
use: Aadhaar-authentication and personal details must be handled securely.

name: EPFO Unified Member Portal
services: UAN, passbook, claims, nominee and member services
use: Authentication-sensitive services; keep credentials/OTP outside AI context.

name: CPGRAMS
services: Public grievance submission and tracking for eligible central and linked government organisations
use: Check scope and forwarding rules; state-specific grievance portals may be more appropriate.

name: RTI Online (Central Government)
services: RTI applications and first appeals for Central Public Authorities
use: Do not route State Government RTI applications here; identify the relevant State RTI portal.

name: DILRMP State/UT Land Records Directory
owner: Department of Land Resources, Ministry of Rural Development
services: State/UT Record of Rights, BhuNaksha and land-record links
use: Authoritative state/UT land-record directory; some link availability differs by state.

name: NGDRS State/UT Registration Website Directory
owner: Department of Land Resources, Ministry of Rural Development
services: State/UT registration department portals, valuation, deed templates and registration workflows
use: The directory lists each state/UT domain and explicitly marks some as unavailable.

name: National Single Window System
services: Know Your Approvals, central approvals and many state business approvals
use: For business approvals, not general citizen certificates; the platform itself advises checking government portals for other requirements.
